svg.title: Mask content outside the mask region does not reveal the masked element
svg.desc: Each masked path is a square inside the mask region and a ring outside it, and each mask holds a white rect larger than the path. Only the squares show. Top left: maskUnits="userSpaceOnUse". Bottom right: the default objectBoundingBox units on a rotated path, where the ring reaches into the corners of the region's bounding box.
